name: cli-automation-worker
description: Shell-first automation starter that chains AgentPM tools with agentpm run --input-file.

variables.name: project_name
variables.description: Generated project name. Generation-time only; do not use for API keys, tokens, passwords, or runtime secrets.

variables.name: workflow_label
variables.description: Human-readable label used in the generated README and output report.

variables.name: source_path
variables.description: Default local source document processed by the generated automation script.

variables.name: output_path
variables.description: Default markdown report path written by the generated automation script.
